text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of summer camp.
I've prepared two different
training
regimens for Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In short, there's one she can do alone and
another that would require
the two of us
to work as a team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I show her both options and make it clear
that I'm fine with either, but
she's taking
an uncharacteristically long time to
respond.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Let me think about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She takes both printouts and heads to her
lodging.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(These regimens... they're both really
well-thought-out.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Even the most basic exercises have been
tweaked to bring out my
strengths...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(The whole training program is tailored for
my running... for me.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer said either one is fine, but it's
obvious when you compare
them—what I
need right now... is to work together with
my trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (But still...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Trainer? About my regimen, um...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I... I think...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That I... I need...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She struggles to find the words. Her
answer is already formed—she
just can't
bring herself to say it out loud.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can tell she doesn't want to hurt my
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She chooses the solo regimen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch her progress, taking notes like
always. I'll gladly do whatever I
can to
support her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At night, I crack open her recommended
reading and gaze up at the
sky, where the
Summer Triangle stands out above the
rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm flipping through the book, trying to
find the right page, when...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Altair... The brightest star in Aquila.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega appears beside me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah... guess so.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Training today was... nice. It felt
worthwhile... like I was making real

progress.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah... But, um...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...The more you do for my sake, the more
my heart hurts.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
All your expectations, your hard work,
they... they should've been for
my sister,
not me...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And yet... here I am...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't claim to know much about her
sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do know, however, that her sister is very
dear to her... and also a
source of great
heartache.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the schedules I put together, all the
advice I give—they're not
meant for her
alone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: For... us?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Both me... and her...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Ah... so that's what it was.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(That time I turned back without going to
see the stars...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Or started a conversation at the
planetarium...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Maybe that wasn't me... but us all along.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She takes a seat next to me, looks up at
the dazzling sky...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I guess I could teach you a thing or two.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...And whispers to me the secrets of stars
that traveled light years to
shine brilliantly
here tonight.
